clauses.title: Scope – Requirements and
clauses.text: 1. Scope - Requirements and the methods of sampling and test for preformed calcium silicate insulation intended for use with surfaces with reach temperatures up to 9500C.

clauses.title: Bulk Density – The
clauses.text: 2.1 Bulk Density -  The average value shall be between 220 and 280 kg/m3. For any particular product, a tolerance of ±10 percent shall be allowed on the purchaser's declared value and shall be within the range specified above.

clauses.title: Compressive Strength – The
clauses.text: 2.2 Compressive Strength - The reduction in thickness under the following conditions shall not exceed 5 percent. a) Dry, under a load of 415 kN/m2; and b) Wet (after 18 hours immersion in water), under a load of 170 kN/m2.

clauses.title: Flexural Strength – The
clauses.text: 2.3 Flexural Strength - The minimum value shall be 240 kN/m2.

clauses.title: Heat Resistance – When
clauses.text: 2.4 Heat Resistance - When tested at increasing temperatures, the material shall be deemed suitable for use under conditions of soaking heat, for 24 hours, up to the temperature at which the following requirements are met: a) Linear shrinkage 2 percent (length), percent Max b) Loss in mass, 15 percent percent, Max c) Compressive Reduction in thickness strength   not exceeding 5 percent under a load of 345 kN/m2

clauses.title: Thermal Conductivity
clauses.text: 2.5 Thermal Conductivity Mean Thermal Temperature Conductivity, Max 0C W/mK 200 0.080 250 0.088 300 0.097 350 0.110 400 0.121 450 0.135 500 0.148

clauses.title: Moisture Content – Shall
clauses.text: 2.6 Moisture Content -  Shall not exceed 7.5 percent by mass.

clauses.title: Alkalinity – The pH
clauses.text: 2.7 Alkalinity - The pH of the solution of the material shall be between 8.0 and 11.0.

clauses.title: Standard Shapes, Size and Dimensional Tolerance
clauses.text: 2.8 Standard Shapes, Size and Dimensional Tolerance

clauses.title: Shapes – Shall be
clauses.text: 2.8.1 Shapes - Shall be supplied in the form of flat slabs, bevelled lags, pipe sections or radiused and bevelled lags.

clauses.title: Standard sizes
clauses.text: 2.8.2 Standard sizes  - a) Flat blocks - Length - 500 mm, 600 mm or 900 mm Width - 150 mm, 300 mm, 450 mm or 600 mm Thickness - 25 mm, 40 mm, 50 mm, 60 mm, 75 mm, or 100 mm b)    Bevelled lags - Length - 500 mm, 600 mm or 900 mm Major width - 75 mm to 166 mm Thickness - 40 mm, 50 mm, 60 mm or 75 mm c) Pipe sections - Length - 500 mm, 600 mm or 900 mm Diameter - To fit standard pipe of external dia up to 219 mm Thickness - 40 mm, 50 mm or 75 mm Note - For method of tests, refer to Appendices A and B of the standard, IS 5688 : 1982 Method of test for preformed block-type and pipe covering type thermal insulation (first revision), IS 5724 : 1970 Methods of tests for thermal insulating cements and IS 9490 : 1980 Method of determination of thermal conductivity of insulation materials (water calorimeter method). For  detailed information, refer to IS 9428 : 1993  Specifications  for  preformed calcium silicate insulation (for temperatures upto 950ºC) (first revision).

clauses.title: Curved segments (radiused and bevelled
clauses.text: 2.8.2.1 Curved segments (radiused and bevelled lags) -  Shall be furnished in lengths of 600 mm or 900 mm and in thickness of 40 mm, 50 mm, or 75 mm for curved surface having external radius greater than 110 mm.

clauses.title: Dimensional Tolerance
clauses.text: 2.8.3 Dimensional Tolerance a) Flat blocks Length and width ± 3 mm Thickness - 1.5 mm ± 3 mm b) Pipe sections Length ± 3 mm Inside diameter - 0 mm + 5 mm Thickness (average) - 1.5 mm + 3 mm

clauses.title: Uniformity – The local
clauses.text: 2.8.3.1 Uniformity - The local thickness of the preformed thermal insulation material at any point shall not very from the average thickness by more than ±3 mm.
